svg.title: Flight attendant — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as flight attendant, wearing a flight uniform. Visible work cue: A two-shelf cabin service trolley carries a small handled cup and has a side push handle and two wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face.
